shots.focal_element: Glowing vanishing point at the end of a curved, glossy pink corridor with a small cylindrical object in the distance
shots.what_happens: The camera glides forward and banks through an abstract rendered space of rounded pink walls and a reflective floor; a curved wall on the right sweeps across and fills more of the frame by the end, with heavy motion blur on the near surfaces.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a 3D corridor of soft-filleted pink matte walls on a glossy floor with a bright emissive horizon strip, and animate a forward dolly with a slight yaw while applying motion blur and bloom to the light source.

shots.focal_element: A clear, glass-like ribbed cylinder sitting centre-frame on a reflective pink surface
shots.what_happens: The camera starts close on the translucent cylinder and pulls back, so it shrinks in frame and the curved pink walls of the surrounding space appear at the frame edges by the last frame; light streaks run horizontally behind it.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a refractive glass cylinder with stacked ring bevels on a mirror-like pink floor, light it with a bright horizontal backlight, and animate a smooth pull-out over about 2 s with depth-of-field blur on the background.

shots.focal_element: The glass cylinder framed between two rounded pink wall forms
shots.what_happens: A wider, symmetrical view of the same glass cylinder flanked by two curved walls; the camera eases back and the walls darken and grow in frame, framing the object like a portal.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame the glass cylinder symmetrically between two mirrored rounded wall meshes, crossfade in from the close-up, and dolly back slowly while the side walls fall into shadow.

shots.focal_element: The brightly lit end of a symmetrical pink tunnel, where the glass object sits
shots.what_happens: The camera rushes down a straight symmetrical pink tunnel toward the glowing object at its end; by the last frame the image has dissolved into a soft, defocused pink-white bloom that bridges into the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a fast forward dolly down a symmetrical tunnel toward an emissive centre, ramping motion blur and a full-frame Gaussian blur plus bloom to maximum over the final ~0.3 s so the next shot can resolve out of the blur.

shots.composition_other: Low-angle product hero: the phone's top edge and camera bump sit on a near-horizon line across the lower half of the frame against a plain light background, with the subject drifting from off-centre toward centre
shots.focal_element: The pink phone's dual-camera bump on the frosted back glass
shots.what_happens: Out of the blur, an extreme low-angle macro of the pink phone's edge and camera rings resolves; the camera pulls back and orbits across the back of the phone (side buttons, then the embossed logo pass by) and ends pushing in on the dual-camera bump with flash, now near frame centre.
shots.build_rebuild: Load the phone model on a seamless off-white backdrop, keep the camera just above the back-glass plane, and animate one continuous ~8 s pull-out that turns into an orbit and ends with a slow push-in on the camera bump, using a shallow depth of field.
